The selected PMXT sample has bounded one-off NT parser/provider, OrderBookDelta, TradeTick, ParquetDataCatalog read-back, BacktestNode, and result-contract evidence. Do not start broad PMXT backfill until reusable coverage, throughput, dynamic tick-size replay, and acceptance proof are committed.

Official Kalshi historical data may support lower-fidelity Bar or TradeTick projection, but BTE currently admits only TradeTick and has no staged sample-to-catalog read-back proof for Kalshi. Historical L2 order-book replay is not proven from the official API.

Treat as a higher-fidelity Kalshi candidate discovered by BTE-025, not as selected input. The bounded sample proves orderbook_snapshot/orderbook_delta schema, but it has no trades, no accepted BinaryOption instrument mapping, null source timestamps on snapshot rows, and no NT catalog read-back.
Keep as metadata-only/current-only. It cannot become NT replay catalog input until source-backed checked BinaryOption fields and accepted historical outcome replay coverage exist.

non_hardcoding_rules_for_the_next_mappin: Add NT data-class support by table family and source schema contract, not by venue name.
Keep concrete source bindings in TOML/proof artifacts and keep runtime mapping selected through source proof, not code constants.
Reuse NT instrument providers/parsers where NT already owns a venue instrument model.
Only build Bolt-owned adapters for raw-source-to-NT-typed data projection when NT does not already provide that raw-source parser.
Each new data class must have ParquetDataCatalog write and query_typed_data read-back proof before BacktestNode input is accepted.
